original_test_intent: Verify the dedicated 32-bit Type 7 Installed Cache Size 2 field is present on applicable cache records, encodes the approved installed capacity/granularity, is selected consistently by the legacy Installed Cache Size field, does not exceed Maximum Cache Size 2 and persists after reboot.
original_method: Capture raw Type 7 structures, bounds-check formatted length, extract Installed Size 2 and its granularity by specification offset, retain legacy installed and extended maximum fields, validate selector/capacity relationships per cache handle, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves extended installed values, zero/not-installed semantics, granularity, legacy selector, maximum relationship and reboot plan. Raw validation is automatable.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS revision and minimum Type 7 formatted length/offset for Installed Size 2
Expected extended installed capacity or approved not-installed state per cache handle
Legacy Installed Cache Size selector relationship
Expected Maximum Cache Size 2 and validated raw parser plus approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not resize, disable, flush or reconfigure caches or firmware.
Do not rely on a literal `Installed Size 2` display line; preserve raw bytes, formatted length and exact 32-bit field.
Bounds-check decoding and retain legacy installed, Installed Size 2 and Maximum Cache Size 2 with their granularity bits.
Require effective installed capacity not to exceed effective maximum and distinguish a defined zero/not-installed value from missing/short data.
Stop on unsupported length, invalid selector/unit/zero relationship, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Extract raw Installed Size 2 per applicable Type 7 record, decode units/zero state, validate legacy selector and maximum relationship before/after reboot.
Do not alter caches, substitute OS capacity or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve field layout/version, per-cache extended installed values, zero/granularity and selector/maximum rules.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The literal label is decoder-dependent and cannot prove raw field presence, formatted-length bounds, unit/zero semantics or legacy/maximum relationships.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a validated raw Type 7 parser to capture formatted length, legacy installed word, Installed Size 2 and Maximum Cache Size 2 with granularity; retain decoded output secondarily.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The dedicated Installed Size 2 scope, Type 7 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode Installed Size 2 directly from each sufficiently long Type 7 structure, preserve raw granularity/value and zero state, confirm legacy selection and validate effective installed bytes against Maximum Cache Size 2 before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 7 records whose revision/length includes Installed Size 2.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, Type 7 length, BIOS, CPU/cache topology and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 7 Installed Size 2 layout/granularity/selector and Maximum Cache Size 2 semantics, approved cache topology and installed parser documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces decoder-label filtering with direct bounds-checked extended field and relationship validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Improves coverage by proving the actual installed-size encoding and not-installed/maximum relationships.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Extended installed/maximum baseline and encoding rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Decoders may fold the extended value into a normalized Installed Cache Size line; raw parsing is needed to retain this dedicated field coverage.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a zero/not-installed extended value or exact installed capacity by cache handle, but only under documented SMBIOS semantics and with an explicit maximum/configuration relationship.
expected_evidence: Approved Type 7 extended installed-field definition, per-cache installed/maximum values, zero/granularity/selector rules and parser versions
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 7 bytes with handle/level, length, legacy installed word, Installed Size 2 and Maximum Cache Size 2
Bounds, selector, zero and installed-not-greater-than-maximum results
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot raw comparison
Engineer verdict or revision/length-based not-applicable determination

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Preserves distinct Installed Size 2 coverage and explicitly handles zero/not-installed semantics.

review_improvement: Detects malformed extended installed-size encoding or impossible installed/maximum relationships hidden by a normalized decoder line.
independent_technical_reasoning: With field definition and approved values supplied, bounds checking, raw decoding, relationship checks and reboot persistence are deterministic software operations.
